Name: Storage Terminal
Author: Manoboca07
Description:
[b]Storage Terminal[/b]
Adds a Storage Terminal that links every nearby chest into a network — view and use everything from one interface, AE2-style.
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Links all chests within a configurable radius (default 10 tiles)[/*]
[*]Unified inventory: withdraw/deposit from any linked chest without opening it[/*]
[*]Sort by name or quantity, with a live search filter[/*]
[*]Place a Workbench next to it to craft using materials from the whole network[/*]
[*]Fully translated (English/Portuguese, follows your game language)[/*]
[/list][b]How to get it[/b]
Craft the Storage Terminal after reaching [b]Mining level 4[/b] (recipe unlocks automatically on level-up). Ingredients: [b]5 Iron Bar, 3 Refined Quartz, 1 Battery Pack[/b].
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, for settings)[/*]
[/list][b]Compatibility[/b]
No known conflicts. Works alongside Automate, Chests Anywhere, etc.
